Info

Unified serial packet encoder and command formatter for SCARA microcontroller.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.communication.protocol.command_formatter.CommandFormatter[source]¶

Bases: MotionCommandFormatter, ConfigCommandFormatter, ToolCommandFormatter

Unified serial packet encoder combining motion, configuration and tool commands.

Inherits all motion formatting methods from MotionCommandFormatter, configuration formatting methods from ConfigCommandFormatter, and actuator/tool/wait/override methods from ToolCommandFormatter.
